programme.desc: Tonight, expect a surprising and delightful menu, because Adam has asked culinary young guns Nat Thaipun and Tom Forrest to surprise him.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
programme.desc: David is in Catania to feast at a gourmet seafood restaurant in a chaotic fish market, experiences the slow roasted flavours and strict traditional rules of Rome's oldest porchetta shop.

programme.title: Matched
programme.desc: A mother's wish surprises everyone when she proposes her daughter Harpreet have an arranged marriage to her flat mate Sahil. Unexpectedly, Sahil agrees to sacrifice his dream Hindu wedding to transform himself into a Sikh groom. And for Rajwinder and Gurvinder, an arranged marriage is the way they thought they would find love.

programme.title: Matched
programme.desc: Atul and Manolata met on a matrimonial website. After a year of dating in secret, love has struck, but not everyone believes they are a good match. Manolata's family doubt Atul's intentions, putting the wedding in jeopardy. And happy-go-lucky Prem is approaching a deadline, find a wife in New Zealand or return to India for an arranged marriage.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: Bamay

programme.desc: Whales near New York harbour, millions of oysters cleaning the coastal waters, birds of prey between skyscraper canyons and Central Park. 'Archipelago New York - An Island City' is a voyage of discovery into the fascinating natural landscape of the world's most famous big city. There, committed New Yorkers are implementing new measures against the climate crisis.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob
programme.desc: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob tells the saga of the extended royal family that once ruled the whole of Europe, and how their loves, marriages and feuds dragged the continent into the world's first total war and violent revolution. Told through the eyes of Queen Victoria's granddaughters - the Hesse sisters, the series lifts the lid on the family tensions which set cousin against cousin and saw millions plunged into the bloodiest war the world had ever known.

programme.title: Mahjong & Mahashas
programme.desc: Mahjong and Mahashas is a rich and vibrant smorgasbord: it is a migration story of a unique Jewish diaspora told through an archival exploration of a family's culture and heritage. The clatter of the mahjong tiles, the delicious aroma of middle eastern spices and the celebration of age old traditions, are some of the flavours in the melting pot that is Sydney's Singaporean Sephardic community.

Searching for his mysterious great grandfather, who he thinks is Maori, leads Stephen to a remote island in the Pacific Ocean, and an emotional meeting with family he never knew he had.

programme.title: No Distance Between Us
programme.desc: No Distance Between Us explores the cultural significance of the largest human fossil footprint site in the world, told through the candid voices of the Traditional Custodians of the Willandra Lakes Region, the Barkandji, Mutthi Mutthi and Ngiyampaa people. Featuring an internationally significant place that is not accessible to the public, this film engages with the ancient and continued connection to Country experienced by Australia's First Nations people and the struggle for recognition of Indigenous knowledge.

programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Featuring an internationally significant place that is not accessible to the public, this film engages with the ancient and continued connection to Country experienced by Australia's First Nations people and the struggle for recognition of Indigenous knowledge.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.

programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. 'Archipelago New York - An Island City' is a voyage of discovery into the fascinating natural landscape of the world's most famous big city. There, committed New Yorkers are implementing new measures against the climate crisis.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob
programme.desc: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob tells the saga of the extended royal family that once ruled the whole of Europe, and how their loves, marriages and feuds dragged the continent into the world's first total war and violent revolution. Told through the eyes of Queen Victoria's granddaughters - the Hesse sisters, the series lifts the lid on the family tensions which set cousin against cousin and saw millions plunged into the bloodiest war the world had ever known.

programme.title: Mahjong & Mahashas
programme.desc: Mahjong and Mahashas is a rich and vibrant smorgasbord: it is a migration story of a unique Jewish diaspora told through an archival exploration of a family's culture and heritage. The clatter of the mahjong tiles, the delicious aroma of middle eastern spices and the celebration of age old traditions, are some of the flavours in the melting pot that is Sydney's Singaporean Sephardic community.

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: In this episode of 'Who Do You Think You Are?', artistic director and choreographer Stephen Page investigates his mother's maternal history and is surprised to discover his 2x great grandfather was a charismatic sailor and fisherman from the Philippines who left an extraordinary family legacy. Searching for his mysterious great grandfather, who he thinks is Maori, leads Stephen to a remote island in the Pacific Ocean, and an emotional meeting with family he never knew he had.

programme.title: Arts Centres Keep Our Elders Connected

programme.title: No Distance Between Us
programme.desc: No Distance Between Us explores the cultural significance of the largest human fossil footprint site in the world, told through the candid voices of the Traditional Custodians of the Willandra Lakes Region, the Barkandji, Mutthi Mutthi and Ngiyampaa people. Featuring an internationally significant place that is not accessible to the public, this film engages with the ancient and continued connection to Country experienced by Australia's First Nations people and the struggle for recognition of Indigenous knowledge.

programme.desc: David is in Catania to feast at a gourmet seafood restaurant in a chaotic fish market, experiences the slow roasted flavours and strict traditional rules of Rome's oldest porchetta shop.

programme.title: Matched
programme.desc: A mother's wish surprises everyone when she proposes her daughter Harpreet have an arranged marriage to her flat mate Sahil. Unexpectedly, Sahil agrees to sacrifice his dream Hindu wedding to transform himself into a Sikh groom. And for Rajwinder and Gurvinder, an arranged marriage is the way they thought they would find love.

programme.title: Matched
programme.desc: Atul and Manolata met on a matrimonial website. After a year of dating in secret, love has struck, but not everyone believes they are a good match. Manolata's family doubt Atul's intentions, putting the wedding in jeopardy. And happy-go-lucky Prem is approaching a deadline, find a wife in New Zealand or return to India for an arranged marriage.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

'Archipelago New York - An Island City' is a voyage of discovery into the fascinating natural landscape of the world's most famous big city. There, committed New Yorkers are implementing new measures against the climate crisis.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob
programme.desc: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob tells the saga of the extended royal family that once ruled the whole of Europe, and how their loves, marriages and feuds dragged the continent into the world's first total war and violent revolution. Told through the eyes of Queen Victoria's granddaughters - the Hesse sisters, the series lifts the lid on the family tensions which set cousin against cousin and saw millions plunged into the bloodiest war the world had ever known.

programme.title: Mahjong & Mahashas
programme.desc: Mahjong and Mahashas is a rich and vibrant smorgasbord: it is a migration story of a unique Jewish diaspora told through an archival exploration of a family's culture and heritage. The clatter of the mahjong tiles, the delicious aroma of middle eastern spices and the celebration of age old traditions, are some of the flavours in the melting pot that is Sydney's Singaporean Sephardic community.

Searching for his mysterious great grandfather, who he thinks is Maori, leads Stephen to a remote island in the Pacific Ocean, and an emotional meeting with family he never knew he had.

programme.title: Arts Centres Keep Our Elders Connected

programme.title: No Distance Between Us
programme.desc: No Distance Between Us explores the cultural significance of the largest human fossil footprint site in the world, told through the candid voices of the Traditional Custodians of the Willandra Lakes Region, the Barkandji, Mutthi Mutthi and Ngiyampaa people. Featuring an internationally significant place that is not accessible to the public, this film engages with the ancient and continued connection to Country experienced by Australia's First Nations people and the struggle for recognition of Indigenous knowledge.

programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. programme.title: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob
programme.desc: Queen Victoria's Royal Mob tells the saga of the extended royal family that once ruled the whole of Europe, and how their loves, marriages and feuds dragged the continent into the world's first total war and violent revolution. As he digs through old archives and traces forgotten victims, he begins to grasp the true scale of what he is dealing with. What follows is an investigation that will consume him entirely, as the search for answers becomes ever more urgent.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: There is nothing like the strong seductive smell of washed rind cheeses to bring back evocative memories of a visit to France. Will travels to the misty Vosges Mountains of Alsace, the green undulating countryside of Normandy and the pretty village of Epoisse in Burgundy to look at four benchmark monastic cheeses. These are Munster, Pont L’eveque, Livarot and Epoisse. These luscious stinky cheeses have a long history but until recently were threatened with extinction and their growing popularity today is largely due to the vision and hard work of a few very passionate family owned dairies.
